business_problem: DDI needed to automate the scoring of behavioral simulations because human assessors took up to two days to review responses and produce reports for leadership-development customers.
solution_summary: DDI uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Unity Catalog, MLflow, and Databricks Model Training to support AI scoring and reporting for behavioral simulations. DDI needed to automate the scoring of behavioral simulations because human assessors took up to two days to review responses and produce reports for leadership-development customers. In practice, the implementation governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, and runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform. Documents, notes, and structured records are consolidated into a governed cloud data layer; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic. The case study reports Helping companies develop exceptional leaders 10 seconds, to generate a simulation report, down from 48 hours, and 100% increase, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: DDI reported Helping companies develop exceptional leaders 10 seconds, to generate a simulation report, down from 48 hours, and 100% increase, improving AI scoring and reporting for behavioral simulations with measurable gains in productivity improvement, customer experience, and speed to market.
